items.text: Hey everyone,

Just a quick update, since I finally got around to adding sound settings to Sizeable! Sorry it has been so long before these settings were added, but Sizeable started out as a project for my masters degree, so it wasn't coded as cleanly as it should have been! Adding these settings took a lot longer than expected.
If I find the time in between other projects of ours, I will try to add a windowed mode to the game too.
I also fixed some stuff in the Diorama mode (deleting not working for example). Hopefully this will make your diorama building expierence a lot better!
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & the Business Goose Team
Hey everyone,

notes.title: A few things have now been fixed

items.text: Steam cloud should now be fully working.
You can now unlock the seasonal levels again
The secret levels and world 6 where overlapping in the level select, this has been fixed.
Fixed an issue where the save file didn't remember if you had previously unlocked the diorama mode.
Let us know if you run into any new problems, and we will try to fix them right away!
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & the Business Goose Team
Hey everyone,

After a long time, steam cloud saving has finaly been added to Sizeable! You should be able to just start from your old save file without losing any data, since a lot of the save game state had to be rewritten, we hope this won't cause any issues for any of you! If issues do arise tho, just let us know on discord or here on the steam community forum!
We also changed 3 things that weren't very clear in certain levels! We will hide these as spoilers so that people who haven't played these levels don't get spoiled! :D
Sky Island: The Gang plank was changed to something that grabs the attention of the player.
Sizeable: Same thing as Sky Island.

Lantern City: The pipe most people missed is now hopefully easier to spot.: Thank you all for the continued support and for playing Sizeable! :D Make sure to join our community discord for future updates about Swan Song or any giveaways (because we are getting really close to 100K units sold!): Cheers,: Sander Ambroos & the Business Goose Team
Hey everyone,
But all these new players have also lead to the discovery of a few minor issues that have been since fixed:
Fixed an issue with the catapult stone in the medieval level. It sometimes didn't get deleted which caused multiple stones to exist and break the market stalls.
Fixed 2 Chinese translation errors in the "Oz" and "Arcade" levels.

The alternative controls for growing and shrinking have been changed to the up and down arrow keys, instead of S & G. These letters initially stood for Shrink and Grow, but since rotating already was the left and right arrow keys, the up and down ones made more sense!

notes.title: We are still looking into the following issues

items.text: Sometimes achievements don't get unlocked properly.
There currently is no cloud save, and I should have added this a long time ago, but the game is giving me a hard time with it. I hope to get this fixed next week!
Finally, we would like to tell all new players about our community discord as well! Feel free to join by clicking on this link: https://discord.com/invite/hyEhfENBQN

We are currently running a small contest where you can win a free Sizeable steam key to gift to a friend, as well as acces to the alpha of Swan Song (our next game), when that is done in a few weeks! :D Just tell us about your favorite level or moment in Sizeable in the discord chat! You can already try the prototype version tho on the steam page:
Thanks again for all the continued support! ♥♥
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & the Business Goose Team
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since I last posted something! We have been hard at work getting 30 Birds ready for beta (and eventually release), while also starting a prototype for our next game after 30 Birds (more about that later this year, so keep an eye on our community discord). After a lot of consideration, I have decided to remove the "Faster then Ero?!" achievement from the game. After all this time, reading some of the reviews and seeing some of the feedback/issues people reported on the community forum, the achievement just wasn't worth keeping. It has been a bit of a weird achievement, since it was such an opposite of what Sizeable was meant to be: A relaxing exploration/puzzle experience. I want to say congrats to everyone who has managed to get the achievement in the past, and to the new players, no need to try to rush through the game anymore!
We hope you all understand and that this decission makes sense!
Untill the next announcement and thank you for all the continued support,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team
Hi everyone,

We just pushed a new small update that fixes some reported bugs and adds some small quality of life changes! This will probably be the final bug fix for Sizeable, but let us know if you find any more so we can plan another one in the future!
Fixed a 4th pillar being available in the sky island level!
Fixed an issue where when you pressed the left or right arrow key, the level would slowly spin!
Added a discription to the scroll speed buttons in the options menu to make it clearer what these settings actually do!
Added the ability to rotate the level using the arrow keys! This should make it easier to play the game on a laptop with a track pad!
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team

releases.displayName: A Quick update about Sizeable's future!

items.text: Hi everyone! Sander here!
Just wanted to make this quick post to give a bit of an update about the future of Sizeable, the final level pack, the promised prizes and our other projects!
For anyone who is looking to talk to us more easily, see a few more updates or talk with our community, make sure to join our discord through this link: https://discord.com/invite/hyEhfENBQN

notes.title: Sizeable's Future & the final level pack

items.text: Things have been a bit silent around Sizeable and the final level pack these past couple weeks/months! Were very busy with 2 other games we are co-creating (more about these down below)! We should have communicated this earlier, so sorry about that! But now, we can announce the winners of the diorama mode contest that will inspire the final level pack down below! One of these levels has already some development, but just to be clear: Don't expect the update to launch in July! Ce are currently aiming towards a august/september 2022 release because of the other projects!

We also have received our Switch Dev kit! So after the final level pack is done & released; we will be working on a switch port (with MAYBE 1 or 2 extra levels that could be ported to PC, we are not sure yet)!

Here is a small spoiler of one the levels from the (currently unnamed) community inspired update! It's simply called Sizeable and will focus on all of my favorite levels from the game and how the interactions/puzzles from those levels can be used in new fun ways! Note that the level is far from finished!

Next we would like to announce the winners of the community Diorama mode contest! Their prizes will be send out once the (unnamed) community update goes live! The atual products they will be receiving will be shown here in a future update aswel once we actually received them! The winners are not in a specific order, we loved them all equally! These are the levels that will be used as inspirations for the final level pack and they will ofcourse be mentioned in the end credits (and in some way in the level itself aswel)! Thank you to everyone who participated, we saw some great creations!
TITAN STRIKES - CHARMSIL
MIXED SCENE - LOKE.NORDESJO
UNNAMED - 大橘子
PACMAN - YETIFROOD (posted in the community discord, not on steam)

Next to Sizeable we are currently working on a few other games aswel! Because we are only a team of 3, this means we really have to manage our time during our work hours! So that's the reason why sizeable got pushed back a little bit currently!
Our first project that we are co-creating together with Ram Ram Games is "30 Birds"! You can check out the steam page here:
The second game we are co-creating together with CVS-Gaming is "Musical Chairs"! Check out the Indigo trailer here:
And last but not least, Beau and I have been working on a small boardgame called "Dino Dino" that will be published by Bannan Games!

We hope everything is clearer now on what you should expect from us the coming weeks/months! We promise to be more transparent and give you more updates on progress in the future! Thanks again for all the support <3!
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team
Hey Eveyrone,
We saw your feedback and bug reports and have been working hard to fix them all! Down below is a full list of all the issues that have been fixed:
The "Eggcelent!" achievement should now be unlockable!
The discription of the "Eggcelent!" achievement has been changed to 17 eggs instead of 16.
The water in the sewers secret level has been fixed.
The ladder in the wonderland level now properly works again!
The "1" Pillar in the Easter Main Menu no longer drops through the floor.
The sprinkler in the Farm level has been fixed!
We are sorry for these inconveniences! If you find any new issues, don't hesitate to let us know!
Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team
